Validate auth-service/postgres-auth stability to stop upstream error amplification at the api-gateway. Consider circuit-breaking tool-executor calls and rolling back any recent RAG pipeline changes.
summary: A critical fault state is active across the stack with a 24.8% overall error rate and a severe p99 latency of ~28.6 seconds. The injected rag_quality_degradation scenario is corrupting the RAG retrieval pipeline (memory-service, vector-db, embed-service), cascading into 239 GenAI tool failures, 32 token truncations, and broad error amplification through the agent-service, api-gateway, auth, and payments services.
